.]] Ironstriders are mechsuits conceived by the Machine Speakers earthen for their mining operations in the Ringing Deeps and protect their settlements. They can be either piloted or programmed to operate automatically. The earliest ironstriders had a risk of over-thermalization due to the power source at the heart of the machine, until the Machine Speakers innovated to counter the problem. Cooperation between the newly-awakened earthen Ordinants and the Arathi smiths of Hallowfall has resulted into an improved, light-forged earthen mechsuit.
Isiset, Construct of Magic is an item card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set depicting Isiset.
Ivarus was a member of the green dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause, and was among those taken to the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel for questioning.

Ivory Tufted Cranes are cranes found at the river between Feathermane Hunting Grounds, Moonfall Approach, and Irongrove Retreat in Suramar. They can be seen surrounded by juvenile Tufted Crane Chicks.

Iszy is a bronze whelp vendor located in Zaralek Cavern and in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken. In her whelp form, she sells Vault of the Incarnates gear in exchange for Antique Bronze Bullion during Dragonflight Season 4. She is also present in her visage form selling Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible gear, and drake form, selling Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope gear.

Iszinormi is a bronze drake vendor located in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken. In her drake form, she sells Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope gear in exchange for Antique Bronze Bullion during Dragonflight Season 4. She is also present in her visage form selling Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible gear, and whelp form as Iszy, selling Vault of the Incarnates gear.
Itchbite is a nerubian companion sold in limited quantity by Clutchmother Marn'tiq, "Calmest" Gobbu, and Tyro Uwe in the City of Threads for 500 .
Island Proudfeathers are peafowl located on the Three Shields on Isle of Dorn.

It's a Plunderful Life is an account-wide feat of strength for acquiring 250,000 Plunder in Plunderstorm matches. The total amount collected is visible on the Plunderstorm character select screen, and during matches in the menu in the upper right. On retail realms, the tracking macro below will link the achievement and display the current total: /run local c,_,_,_,a,b=BreakUpLargeNumbers,GetAchievementCriteriaInfo(20509,1) print(GetAchievementLink(20509),c(a),"of",c(b),C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyLink(2922))

Isles Butterflies are butterflies. They appear regularly in great numbers over the course of thirty minutes around the adventurer after interacting with a Butterfly Lantern at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
It's Nearly Midnight is a feat of strength earned for logging in anytime between 29 January and 2 March 2026, the launch of . It rewards the Miniature Replica Dark Portal housing decor.
Iv'javal is a nerubian innkeeper located in the Skittering Lounge in the City of Threads.
J. Shine is a pandaren ghost located in Brewmoon Festival. He acts as a Spirit Healer.

Izaeh Strongiron is an Arathi teacher holding a lesson for a group of five Arathi Children inside a house in Lorel's Crossing, Hallowfall. The Big Book of Arathi Idioms is lying on a crate next to the group. When Hallowfall came under threat once again by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Izaeh answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed at Lothar's Landing.

Jae Kuen is a stealthed pandaren found in the Shado-Pan Monastery. He is found kneeling in front of a gravestone on a slightly elevated area with a graveyard across the water to the right, just before the first bridge after exiting the Sha of Violence's room. Certain class abilities or profession items have to be used to get some extra height to reach this area, as the edges are steep.
Jadescale Gnashers are jormungar found in Island Expeditions.
Izkrk'tkrzn is a skitterling vendor located in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Jansen Farm Floral Basket is housing decor purchased from "Den" Nightshade in Razorwind Shores and Fel'orei Moonstrider in Founder's Point for .
Jayjay Perry is a goblin located next to a Rocketboard in front of the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.

__NOTOC__ Jester's Board is a food item made with Khaz Algar Cooking (35). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.

.]] The jiro are a race of small automa workers who repair and harmonize Zereth Mortis. They are more quirky, independent, and sentient than their larger kin, which they assist to operate properly. They cluster together in small collectives of linked individuals, named "circles", with each group having their own name prefix and purpose. If they are severed from their circle, the jiro are no longer stable and become a danger to the order of the realm, or are exiled by their brethren. When under attack, they can empower the larger Jiro Prime to restore order. They use neomotes, a necessary creation component, along with Compilation Nodules and Composition Motes to complete their work across th
The Jeweled Eye is found on a statue at Southmoon Ruins in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. It is revealed with the Torch of Pyrreth.
Jix is a goblin flight master located in Gutterville in the Ringing Deeps. She connects with Opportunity Point.
Jings is a goblin located next to a Rocketboard in front of the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.

artwork.)]] Jeweled truncheons were the signature weapons of the death knights of the Old Horde. The strange-looking instruments contained jewels crafted from the hearts and souls of slain necrolytes which empowered their wielders with necromantic energies.
Jeweled Broodwatchers are beetles found in Island Expeditions.
Jewelcrafter's Tent is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from The Perenolde Tiara. Additional copies can be purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .

Jostling Ovoid is sold by Izkrk'tkrzn, Uvo'rek the Broodmother, and Violesca in the City of Threads for . If the player knows Recipe: Fine Egg Powder, they can grind the item to produce Fine Egg Powder (and possibly Coagulated Yolk) under the cooking menu interface.
Jocenna is a nightborne housing decor vendor found in Suramar City.
Jormog the Behemoth is a carrion worm located in the Cave of the Bloodtotem in Highmountain.
Juggernaut's Power Core drops from the Iron Juggernaut in the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Journeys is a tab in the Adventure Guide that summarizes the standings with each major faction in a specific expansion (starting from Dragonflight). It provides an overview for each major faction, allows one to track a faction as a status bar (which is also possible through the Reputation tab), and the Great Vault interface can be accessed from the button next to the dropdown menu. It also displays the progress tracks for :Delver's Journey and :Preyseeker's Journey.

The K'areshi ( ) were a race of humanoid beings native to the planet K'aresh. Amidst a massive cataclysmic conflict, later remembered as the Devouring War, they were beset upon by the malevolent void lord Dimensius and the forces of the Void. Unable to prevent the destruction of their homeworld, the majority of the survivors were driven into exile within the Twisting Nether and the Shadowlands, where they would become the ethereals and brokers due to the effects of the Wasting.
Junkyard Clawguards drops from the following creatures in Undermine: *M.A.G.N.O. *Chief Foreman Gutso *Flyboy Snooty *The Junk-Wall *S.A.L.

]] The K'areshi automatons are armored mechanical machines used by the Shadowguard ethereals. They made their first appearance during the war on K'aresh, when the Shadowguard attacked Tazavesh, and could be found among the invaders of the Archival Assault. They were later seen protecting the Shadowguard settlements across K'aresh, and fought alongside Nexus-King Salhadaar in Manaforge Omega. Within Manaforge Omega, the Plexus Sentinel ensured that energy from the shattered world of K'aresh was cleanly filtered into the manaforge's central chamber, and acted as the first line of defense.
K3 Snow Runner is a goblin located next to Transporter Power Cell at Garm's Bane in the Storm Peaks.

Kagoznos was one of Warbringer Rava's lieutenants, and was among those present when Rava and Ryanog delivered evidence that the dragonflights were using the titan-forged to steal primal dragon eggs from unattended nests to Iridikron.
Kaldorei Bags are found at the Terrace of the Moon and by the portal house in Bel'ameth in Amirdrassil.
Kaldorei Horns are found at the Terrace of the Moon and at Dawning Watchtower in Amirdrassil.
Kackle is a crocolisk found on the southern island of the Loch in .

endeavor in Razorwind Shores.]] Kafa is an energizing, addictive, coffee-like beverage made by the grummles of Pandaria from the seeds of the kafa bush, a plant that grows on mountains in Kun-Lai Summit.

Kagfritha is an earthen located at Shadowvein Point in the Ringing Deeps. Before the earthen workers abandoned the Rumbling Wastes, she used to be a site supervisor for operations in the area that was threatened by beasts, including the scorpid Smaragthr, to whom she lost her gems and eye. She works with Sinruna, who she tells to fly higher. When she was late for her shift, and an adventurer let Kagfritha know about it. In order to bring the area into order, she devised a plan that involved obtaining krolusk meat and burning deepflayer nests. With both tasks complete, she asked the adventurer to enact vengeance in her name by using the meat to lure out Smaragthr and kill it.

Kaeleb Flamegard is an Arathi located in the Arathi Infirmary in Mereldar in Hallowfall. He tends to a hall full of Injured Soldiers. Sometimes he receives help from General Steelstrike, and the wounded soldiers think he is nice. During the war in Khaz Algar, he was assisted by an adventurer. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Kaeleb answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed at Lothar's Landing, where he could be seen healing wounded soldiers.
Kah'net is a nerubian found in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Kaheti Scribe's Records are housing decor obtained as an achievement reward from Smelling History. Additional copies can be purchased from Thripps in the City of Threads for .

Kapara, also called capybaras, snooters, snoofers, and possibly snorfs, are a race of stocky rodents with small horns found in several parts of Azeroth, including Zul'Aman, Mechagon Island, and Felwood. They have a very good sense of smell and can easily find grass and seeds buried under snow or scrap. Some burrow under wet foliage to rest. In Zul'Aman, kapara are servants of Filo, the Loa of Children, and they may accompany and protect lone forest troll children who go on pilgrimages to seek out the loa. Many kapara enjoy gathering at the Shrine of Filo to relax in its hot springs. Filo may react violently to those who harm wild kapara. Despite their generally placid behavior, kapara seem t

__NOTOC__ Seer Kanai is a Broken of the Ashtongue Deathsworn located inside the Black Temple. After killing High Warlord Naj'entus and Supremus, the Spirit of Olum will allow teleportation directly from the entrance of Black Temple to Kanai. When adventurers invaded the Temple, Kanai asked them to help Akama free his soul by defeating the Shade of Akama and directed them to go with Akama to deal with Illidan Stormrage. With Illidan dead, Kanai proclaimed the Broken free. Many years later, Ashtongue Kanai attended the Tishamaat in the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. He was seen speaking with Vindicator Aluumen.

Kar'cada is a skitterling vendor located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.
Karazhan Syphoner is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for 2200 Timewarped Badge.

Keepsake Continuum is a Deaths of Chromie talent available at Epoch-Mender reputation. It is a choice node with Infinite Velocity.
Kazzquack is a duck located next to Izal Whitemoon in the Azure Span.
Kawaris is a fungarian herbalism trainer located at Flowers for Arachnathon in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.

Kaydee Racketring is a goblin located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine. She is the cartel recruiter, giving players the choice of which of the Cartels of Undermine they wish to assist each week.
__NOTOC__ Kerbjorn was a dwarf located at the T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City during November 2023.
Kel'an is a skitterling located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.

Kha'damu is a jungle troll boss that patrols the main road of during the Blood Moon. Kha'damu will buff players within 200 yards with , and players within 100 yards with , which significantly increase how many stacks of Blood for the Blood Loa they earn. However, Kha'damu is easily aggroed (even through stealth), moves very quickly, and will kill any player he catches in a single hit, making fighting near him a risky - albeit highly rewarding - endeavor. Though Kha'damu has more than 3 million health, it is possible to kill him with a sufficiently large and motivated group of players. Kib'kur is a skitterling found in the Skeins in the City of Threads.

Alchemy from the Khaz Algar proficiency can be trained as early as level 68 and permits progression up to 100 skill points. Khaz Algar Alchemy can be learned from Tarig in Dornogal and Shalba in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet for .

Introduced with Midnight Season 1, the Keystone Victor is a line of feats of strength for Mythic+ dungeons. They are rewarded at the end of a PvE season for those that had the best keystone completion for that dungeon in their region, with future seasons allowing another group to possibly earn it. While the achievements are permanent, the titles are not. Once another player beats the time, the title is removed from the player that previously had it.

Introduced in patch 12.0.5 during Midnight Season 1, the Keystone Myth is a line of feats of strength for Mythic+ dungeons, each being the sixth step in a series of achievements. The achievements require the player to reach Mythic+ Rating 3400 and rewards a Timelost Saddle to obtain past Mythic+ mounts or new recolors. *Midnight Keystone Myth: Season One

The assassin in question is none other than Nexus-Princess Ky'veza, who is hidden in stealth off to the side when heading toward Salhadaar's encounter. She requires clearing an extra pack of mobs that can otherwise be skipped to be found. Speak with her: During the encounter, she will use her Nexus Knives ability from her raid and delve encounters. Kyanite Stonetender is an unbound earth elemental located in the Command Center in Stormwind City and in Orgrimmar. It sells gear in return for the Fissure Stone Fragment currency.

Kulzi is a pango loa located in Shrine of Kulzi in the Zul'Aman. He is the loa of medicine, the living cure that answers only to the patient and those with a caring heart. He helps his faithful, who are usualy alchemists, herbalists and the like, to find the right cure for any disease for any whom his followers decided to heal. However, he isn't all powerful, so when the cure fails, the only way left is to beseech Jan'alai. Kulzi's counterpart is Mot'amra, loa of pestilence, and many of his followers also worship Mot'amra.

Kunzen Ropes are medium-sized coils of rope with turquoise anchors attached. Ella believes the Kunzen Hozen use them to descend from the mountains and raid the Heartland farms.

The legendary ring questline was a questline introduced in that had the garrison commander help Archmage Khadgar hunt down . During the questline, the commander goes on various quests for Khadgar leading them through all of the raids of the expansion and some of its dungeons. As they progressed through the questline the commander would be awarded with an increasingly powerful ring. The events of the questline happen more or less concurrently with the events of the Garrison Campaign and Tanaan Jungle storyline. The questline was removed with the launch of . The questline was divided into four chapters, and the completion of each of them awarded an achievement: Chapter I: Call of the Archmage,

Legplates of Duality drop from the Fangs of the Queen in the City of Threads.
Legion Dungeons: Power of the Ancients is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing each of the following Legion Dungeons on any difficulty with a Timerunner character.
Legionslayer III is a Legion Remix achievement earned by defeating 50 empowered enemies in Heroic World Tier as a Legion Timerunner.

Legion Shocktroopers are doomguard that spawn during Sabotage the Warp-Gate! at Invasion Point: Destroyer in the Netherstorm.

Legionfall Champion's Insignia is a reward from world quests in the Broken Shore. It can also be looted from the treasures throughout the zone or a Cache of Infinite Power. It will be available starting in phase 3 of Legion Remix.
Legion Milling is a Milling ability granted to scribes with Legion proficiency Inscription. It is automatically added upon learning Legion Inscription.

Libram of Banishment teaches the Aura Mastery (paladin rune) rune for pants. In order to use this item, you must first kill 5 enemies with Exorcism (paladin ability) after casting Turn Undead on them while the Libram is equipped.

Liberation of Undermine: The House Loses begins the final chapter of the Undermine(d) campaign, Homecoming. This quest requires a visit to Liberation of Undermine, which opened up the week of 4 March 2025. If completing the raid on any regular difficulty is not in the cards, Story Mode is available and opened the week of 11 March 2025. Speak with Paks Topskimmer in the Incontinental Hotel to use Story Mode. Completing this quest unlocks But What About the Casino?, an optional storyline of the campaign, and Diversified Investments (quest), opening up the Darkfuse Solutions cartel.
Leyscale Manalisks are basilisks found at Ambervale and Moonwhisper Gulch in Suramar. They share spawn points with other nearby basilisks.

Light of Creation is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Light Blue Balloons are summoned by Isaandrae outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. They can be hopped on to fly around the area.
Lightbound Passage is a Legion: Remix ability granted by the Empyreal Orders artifact trait. It activates upon casting Enter the Fray.
Lighting the Dark is a feat of strength earned for defeating Nullaeus in the Torment's Rise challenge delve on Tier ?? (Tier 11) during Midnight Season 1. It rewards the title .

Lil' Jax is a house cat :soulshape located near Priestess Jaxi at the Terrace of the Moon in Amirdrassil. Jax can be petted.

Lightning Bulwark is a Utility ability in Plunderstorm. On use, the character channels for two seconds, negating the next instance of damage. The listed bonuses trigger off of receiving any damage, including basic attacks.
Lil' Blingie is a blingtron. While Blingtron 3000 in the Brawler's Guild has an ability named after this NPC, the one it actually summons is Blingtron 2000.
Lightning Bottle is a delve power obtained from the various treasures during delves.
Lightning Conductor is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.

The Lightwing Dragonhawk is a light-infused dragonhawk mount that can be obtained from Epic Edition or Heroic Edition. Obtaining this mount rewards the Heroic Edition: Lightwing Dragonhawk feat of strength.
Lil' Tusks are small boars found alongside Ol' Big Tusk when the Drill Rig is up at Grunters Hideout on Mechagon Island.
Lightveil Recall Beacon is teleportation toy rewarded from either A Swampy Welcome to Naigtal or A Frigid Welcome to Val.
Limited Immortality Device is a titan device located in the Halls of Infusion at Infuser's Rotunda.

Lions, Tigers, and Bears is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Limal is a skitterling vendor located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.
__NOTOC__ Liv Bradford is a human in the Park in Stormwind City.

Llyot is a fungarian located at Flowers for Arachnathon in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Living Rose is available for purchase for 40x Love Token from Kiera Torres outside Stormwind City and Lythianne Morningspear outside Orgrimmar during Love is in the Air.
Listless Swooppups are mana rays located in Shatter Gorge in K'aresh.

Locus of Power is a meta gem in Pandaria Remix. It can drop from any creature, be contained in a Cache of Infinite Treasure, or the Asynchronized Meta Gem, purchased from Lidamorrutu for 500 Bronze (Pandaria Remix), has a chance of creating this gem.

The Loa Offering is placed upon the Altar of the Loa in Darkspear Hold on the Echo Isles during the Heritage of the Darkspear. Revealed to be a tribute to Mueh'zala, it was destroyed and replaced by one for Jani
The Locus of Infinite Truths is an area within N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It is a central room where a vital appendage resembling N'Zoth's head is fought.

Loader Signal is one of the delve powers that can be obtained from a Necrotic Cauldron during delves. During The War Within Season 1, it was obtained by looting the Molten Engine left behind after defeating the Stolen Loader.
Locust Swarm is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Locals are people of various Alliance and Horde races located on Founder's Point and Razorwind Shores. Those on Founder's Point are humans, dwarves, gnomes, night elves, draenei, worgen, and pandaren. Those on Razorwind Shores are orcs, undead, tauren, trolls, blood elves, goblins, pandaren, Highmountain tauren, and vulpera.
Lodestar of the Great Dark drops from Snaerius in Masters' Perch in the Voidstorm.

Loot-Stuffed Basket was the quest reward from Feathered Fiend for level characters, started by killing Daetan Swiftplume. Characters at or above level will instead receive the Loot-Filled Basket, which has a chance of containing the Noble Flying Carpet mount.
Longsword of the Knight's Pledge is sold for by Bobadormu in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar during a Classic Timewalking event.
Longclaw Furbolgs are furbolgs located on Longclaw Island in the Azure Span.

Lord Godfrey's Old Spectacles can be fished up from the waters in and around Gilneas City in the Ruins of Gilneas.

Lord of the Bling is an account-wide feat of strength for acquiring 150,000 Plunder in Plunderstorm matches. The total amount collected is visible on the Plunderstorm character select screen, and during matches in the menu in the upper right. On retail realms, the tracking macro below will link the achievement and display the current total: /run local c,_,_,_,a,b=BreakUpLargeNumbers,GetAchievementCriteriaInfo(20509,1) print(GetAchievementLink(20509),c(a),"of",c(b),C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyLink(2922))
Lorerunner of Highmountain is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing the following achievements with a Timerunner.
Lorewalker Initiates are pandaren and pandaren ghosts located throughout Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.

Lossain is an ethereal flight master located in Shadow Point in K'aresh. After reaching Renown 5 with the Manaforge Vandals and completing Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow, Lossain also provides raid skips directly to Nexus-King Salhadaar.
